       p.price_minor * 1.0 / m.value,

WHERE p.category = 'kitchen_dining'
GROUP BY p.id;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
           p.category,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at), p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month, category, revenue_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue_minor DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT month, category,
       revenue_minor / CAST((SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS REAL)
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY month, category;

SELECT c.name,
       SUM(o.shipping_minor + COALESCE((
           SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor)
           FROM order_items AS oi
           WHERE oi.order_id = o.id
       ), 0)) / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       )
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 2 DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete' THEN
           COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor)
                     FROM order_items AS i WHERE i.order_id = o.id), 0)
           - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount_minor)
                       FROM refunds AS r WHERE r.order_id = o.id), 0)
           ELSE 0 END)
       / (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM orders AS o
GROUP BY substr(o.placed_at, 1, 7)
ORDER BY 1;

LIMIT 4;

       p.price_minor * 1.0 / m.value,
       MIN(oi.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 / m.value
FROM products AS p
JOIN shop_meta AS m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.category = 'kitchen_dining'
GROUP BY p.id;

WITH category_revenue AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
           p.category,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = i.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at), p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month, category, revenue_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue_minor DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM category_revenue
)
SELECT month, category,
       revenue_minor / CAST(
           (SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS REAL
       )
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY month, category;

SELECT c.name
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
  AND p.category IN ('kitchen_dining', 'outdoor_sports', 'home_office', 'audio_gear', 'home_decor', 'kids_toys')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) = 6;

WITH item_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS total_minor
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) AS total_minor
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT SUBSTR(o.placed_at, 1, 7),
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete'
                THEN COALESCE(i.total_minor, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_minor, 0)
                ELSE 0
           END) / (
               SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
               FROM shop_meta
               WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
           )
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN item_totals AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY SUBSTR(o.placed_at, 1, 7)
ORDER BY 1;

GROUP BY p.id;

GROUP BY p.category;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
           p.category,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = i.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at), p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month, category, revenue_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue_minor DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT month, category,
       revenue_minor / (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
                        FROM shop_meta
                        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY month, category;

SELECT c.name,
       SUM(o.shipping_minor + COALESCE((
           SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor)
           FROM order_items AS oi
           WHERE oi.order_id = o.id
       ), 0)) / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       )
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 2 DESC, c.id
LIMIT 1;

WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS gross_minor
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_minor) AS refunded_minor
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at),
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'delivered_complete'
                THEN COALESCE(i.gross_minor, 0) - COALESCE(r.refunded_minor, 0)
                ELSE 0
           END) / (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
                   FROM shop_meta
                   WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN order_totals AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at)
ORDER BY 1;

ORDER BY 2;
